name: Kimmy
role: CS undergrad · hardware acceleration & post-quantum crypto
tagline: Putting cryptography into silicon, and writing about it afterwards.
intro: Computer Science at National Cheng Kung University. I spend most of my time on the hardware side: RISC-V ISA extensions, FPGA bring-up, and accelerating post-quantum signatures. The rest goes into hackathons, and into writing down what broke.
now: Putting together graduate school applications; the research proposal builds on my capstone work on SLH-DSA hardware acceleration.
2026 DevJam, Google Cloud track — smart maintenance for road convex mirrors and early warning at blind intersections.
Writing up a year of hackathons and hardware projects into something readable.
